facts.fact: Senegal is named as one of the ten member countries of the West African Backbone Network (ROA-BN), created in December 2024 in Conakry.
Ministers in charge of telecommunications and digital affairs of the ten ROA-BN members opened a two-day meeting in Dakar on 8 October 2026, hosted by Senegal, to validate a 2030 strategic vision.
The ROA-BN Interministerial Council, described as its highest political and strategic body, was reported as installed, as of the 8 October 2026 report; no installation date given.
